business_scope.primary_industry_name: Handmade Sharp-Edge Epoxy Resin Liquid Core RPG Dice Casting

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid Civil Law: codified civil-law tradition (Spanish heritage) with strong US-inspired corporate statutes (Ley 32 de 1927) and administrative-law remedies (Ley 38 de 2000); no sub-state fiscal distinctions (Unitary_National)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), in force 2012 (investment chapter)
Panama-Spain DTA and Investment Protection Agreement (2011, DTA in force 2022)
Panama-United Kingdom Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (1983)
Panama-Switzerland Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (1985, in force 1992)
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (in force for Panama, 2021)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework, as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019 and Ley No. 129 de 2020); Private Interest Foundations governed by Ley No. 25 de 12 de junio de 1995 as amended; Beneficial Owner (UBO) centralized register created by Ley No. 70 de 2019 and regulated by Decreto Ejecutivo No. 100 de 2019 and Decreto Ejecutivo No. 56 de 2020; supervision of resident agents as non-financial obliged subjects by the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of Founder's passport (each UBO and officer)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / notary public in the Founder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961 Convention; Panama in force 2007) or Consular Legalization if the origin country is not a Hague Contracting State

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Founder's current proof of residential/business address (utility bill or bank statement, <3 months old)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature certification followed by Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / registration extract of the Founder (if corporate entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the Founder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (preferred) or Consular Legalization at a Panamanian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter covering the Founder/UBO (account conduct, reputability, source of funds attestation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank where the Founder/UBO maintains the funding account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct issuance sealed by issuing bank; notarization may be required by the resident agent for non-English issuers

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foundation Charter (Acta Fundacional and Estatutos) — Spanish or bilingual; notarized before a Panamanian Notary and inscribed with the Registro Público
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian Notary and Registro Público de Panamá
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Panamanian notarization (internal use); Apostille by Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (MIRE) only if the Charter is to be relied upon abroad

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory real-time screening of all Founders, UBOs, council members, officers, and beneficiaries against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN list, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, and Panama's national lists; enhanced due diligence (PEP) triggers: any indication of politically exposed persons, unexplained wealth, sanctions nexus, or connection to high-risk jurisdictions identified by FATF; resident agents must apply Ley 23/2015 CDD standards, verify UBOs above 25% ownership/control, and retain records for not less than five (5) years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — Electronic Docket System (Sistema de Información de Fondaciones y Fideicomisos) via www.registro-publico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Foundation names must be expressed in Spanish or in a Latin-script foreign language and must include the word 'Fundación' (or the foreign equivalent 'Foundation'); non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, Arabic, Mandarin, Hebrew) must be phonetically transliterated into Latin characters in the Charter; the Public Registry will deny identical or deceptively similar names (sounding-alike principle) to any pre-existing entity of any type.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name clearance may be (i) re-filed under a distinct name after a phonetic and literal re-check, or (ii) contested by filing a written 'Recurso de Reconsideración' with the Director General of the Registro Público within fifteen (15) business days of electronic notification, pursuant to Ley 38 de 2000; the Registry must resolve within thirty (30) business days and silence is deemed a negative resolution, which may then be appealed to the First Administrative Court (Tribunal Administrativo) within sixty (60) calendar days; in parallel, a 'certificado de pasos' (temporary blocking certificate) for the proposed name can be obtained to secure the name for the duration of the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The PIF must maintain a physical registered office in Panama at the licensed office of its Resident Agent (a Panamanian attorney or registered law firm); a virtual-only mailbox will NOT satisfy Ley 25 de 1995, Art. 24. The operating business (artisanal epoxy resin dice casting, e-commerce fulfillment, and payment collection via Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal) may be conducted entirely remotely and outside Panama, provided no physical manufacturing, warehousing or payroll is located in Panama (to preserve the territorial tax status and minimal substance profile); a virtual office address may be used for the commercial/operational business in the Founder's home jurisdiction, but not for the PIF's statutory registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<10% per annum). Unannounced on-site inspections by the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF) or the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) are rare for low-risk, non-PEP, standard retail businesses; inspection risk is concentrated on record-based audits of the Resident Agent's compliance files; probability of a physical, unannounced visit to the registered office is estimated at 2-5% annually, increasing only if sanctions/UBO filings become irregular or a PEP is later identified.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry arancel (fee schedule) applicable to foundation dockets

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for certified translation ($25-35/page bundle) plus notarial tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of Foundation Charter (Acta Fundacional), Foundation Bylaws (Estatutos), and initial appointment of Foundation Council
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian corporate law firm (acting as Resident Agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for Law 25 PIF formation, inclusive of Council appointments and resolutions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry arancel, scaled by declared foundation capital (progressive scale; USD 10,000 bracket)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Resident Agent (law firm) in Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; $350-$600 per annum for low-risk standard PIF structures

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory DGI annual tariff for the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales, per Decreto Ejecutivo No. 100 de 2019 as amended by Ley 129 de 2020

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark contingency of 3-5% of total formation costs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley Nº 25 de 12 de junio de 1995 sobre Fundaciones de Interés Privado, as amended by Ley Nº 21 de 2017 (beneficial ownership transparency) and related enabling regulations; applicable sections: Articles 3-10 (foundation charter, endowment, and purpose), Articles 11-21 (Foundation Council, Protector, beneficiaries, and asset reservation rules), Articles 22-30 (registration procedure, legal personality, and registry effects).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Instrumento de Fundación (Foundation Charter / Deed of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley 25 de 1995; the Foundation Charter must declare an initial endowment (patrimonio) capable of fulfilling the foundation's purpose. Market standard minimum is USD 100, with typical endowments of USD 1,000-10,000. No escrow account is mandated; the endowment may consist of cash, movable, or immovable assets identified and segregated at registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDATION COUNCIL OF [FOUNDATION NAME], adopted unanimously on [DATE]: 1. Subscriptions and Endowment: The Council accepts the initial endowment of USD [amount] contributed by the Founder, confirming that the patrimony is fully vested in the Foundation. 2. Registered Office: The registered office shall be the office of the Resident Agent, [Agent Name], in Panama City, Republic of Panama. 3. Officers: The Council appoints [Name] as President, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Treasurer, each authorized to execute banking, tax, licensing, and operational documents. 4. Ratification: All prior acts of the Founder and Resident Agent leading to incorporation are ratified. Adopted, signed, and certified in Panama City this [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Online Portal for Certificates of Availability (Portal de Servicios en Línea)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary name search on the Registro Público online portal. Submit the Solicitud de Certificado de Disponibilidad de Nombre identifying the proposed foundation name, one alternate name, and the founder's particulars. The certificate confirms that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing corporation or foundation. The certificate is valid for 30 calendar days and is a prerequisite for charter notarization.
required_dossiers: Name availability application form (Solicitud de Certificado de Disponibilidad de Nombre)
Copy of founder's passport or national ID
Proposed foundation name and alternate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, file a new application with a different alternate name within the validity window; no registry penalty applies, and the online resubmission is immediate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Resident Agent and Drafting of Foundation Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panama-licensed Resident Agent (Abogado) registered with the Registro Público
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a resident agency agreement appointing a Panama-licensed attorney as the foundation's Resident Agent. Instruct counsel to draft the Instrumento de Fundación in Spanish, specifying the foundation name, purpose (manufacture and sale of handmade epoxy-resin tabletop RPG dice and accessories), term, initial endowment, Founder reserved rights, Foundation Council composition, Protector (optional), beneficiaries, and amendment procedures. Prepare a certified English translation for the client file.
required_dossiers: Signed resident agent engagement agreement
Foundation charter instructions (purpose, endowment, council, protector, beneficiaries)
AML/KYC questionnaire and source-of-funds declaration of the Founder
Proof of initial endowment transfer or asset contribution (bank statement or valuation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Resident Agent or Public Registry flags a prohibited or ambiguous purpose clause, revise the draft charter and re-execute before the notary; private-client confidentiality provisions are preserved under Ley 25 de 1995.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Foundation Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de Panamá (or Panamanian Consul abroad)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Founder executes the Instrumento de Fundación before a Panamanian Notary. If the Founder is abroad, execution may occur before a Panamanian Consul or a foreign notary with apostille. The notary verifies identity, legal capacity, and witnesses, and issues a public instrument (testimonio) to be presented to the Registro Público. Payment of notarial fees is completed and the notary forwards the instrument for registration.
required_dossiers: Final draft Foundation Charter (Instrumento de Fundación)
Founder's original passport or ID
Proof of resident agent appointment
Notarial fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses execution due to incomplete clauses, redraft the deficient clause with the Resident Agent and reschedule the notarial ceremony; a substitution of notary may be made without registry sanction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized testimonio together with the registration fee form and the Resident Agent's domicile acceptance at the Fundaciones de Interés Privado section. The Registrar examines the charter for compliance with Ley 25 de 1995 and issues the inscription entry granting legal personality. Upon inscription, request certified copies (copia certificada) of the registered charter and the foundation's legal status certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized testimonio of the Foundation Charter
Registrar registration fee payment receipt (Tasa Única)
Resident Agent acceptance and registered office address (domicilio)
Power of attorney authorizing counsel to file, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues an observation (observación), the Resident Agent corrects the flagged clauses and resubmits within the statutory 10-day cure period; corrections are formalized by a notarized clarifying instrument at no additional registry fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration (RUC) and Municipal Operating License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Alcaldía del Municipio de Panamá — Dirección de Rentas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form RUC-02 to register the foundation as a taxpayer before the DGI for territorial income tax, ITBMS (transfer tax) if applicable, and tax withholding duties. Then register the commercial activity with the corresponding municipality and obtain the Aviso de Operación (municipal operating license), which triggers the payment of the ICA (tax on commercial and industrial activities). The registered office and warehouse address must be evidenced.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered Foundation Charter
Resident Agent certificate and registered office proof
RUC-02 form signed by the legal representative (Council President)
Municipal Aviso de Operación application and ICA registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI or the municipality rejects or delays due to tax domicile discrepancies, submit the Resident Agent's certified address and, if the charter requires amendment, file a registry amendment before resubmitting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Registration and Fire Safety Inspection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección Nacional de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental; Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Category I environmental registration (Inscripción Ambiental) for low-impact artisanal resin casting, describing the production workflow, chemical storage, ventilation, and waste handling. Schedule a fire safety inspection of the production and storage premises to obtain the annual Fire Safety Inspection Certificate. Register the workplace with MITRADEL for occupational health and safety compliance and with CSS as an employer.
required_dossiers: Category I environmental registration form (Inscripción Ambiental)
Production process description and epoxy resin Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
Wastewater and VOC compliance self-declaration and waste management plan
Fire safety inspection request, floor plan, and lease or title deed
MITRADEL employer registration and workplace health and safety notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MiAMBIENTE reclassifies the activity to Category II, engage an environmental consultant to prepare the Informe Ambiental de Impacto Ambiental within the granted deadline; if fire inspection flags deficiencies, install required extinguishers, ventilation, and egress signage and apply for reinspection within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Dirección de Comercio, jointly with the Alcaldía del Municipio de Panamá for the municipal industrial/commercial operating permit (Aviso de Operación)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación y Licencia Industrial/Comercial Municipal

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección Nacional de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental (DNVDA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I — Inscripción Ambiental (environmental registration) for low-impact artisanal manufacturing of polymer/resin tabletop gaming products; no full EIA report required at the stated small-batch production scale
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: compliance with Executive Decree No. 180 of 2008 (Reglamento de Descargas de Aguas Residuales) — pH 6-9, BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L, TSS ≤ 150 mg/L for non-sanitary discharges to municipal sewers; no uncured resin or solvent may enter water bodies. Air emissions: compliance with Executive Decree No. 5 of 2009 air-quality standards, including VOC workplace exposure limits (TLV) for epoxy resin volatiles and adequate local exhaust ventilation. Solid waste: uncured resin, acetone-contaminated rags, and spent molds must be managed as hazardous/special waste under Ley 41 de 1998 with documented disposal manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Annual Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá covering portable extinguishers, storage separation of flammable resins/solvents, emergency egress, and ventilation; structural load certification of workbench and storage racking areas by a licensed engineer where required; MITRADEL occupational health and safety registration (Comisión de Salud y Seguridad) and CSS employer registration for all production personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; taxpayer portal: Sede Electrónica de la DGI (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Private Interest Foundation must appoint a resident legal representative and register for the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) at DGI. The procedure requires submission of the foundation charter (protocolized and notarized), resident agent certificate, registered address, and identification of the legal representative. If the foundation performs no Panama-source taxable activity, no income tax filing duty arises; however, any ITBMS-taxable export transaction requires a RUC and electronic invoicing capacity before invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Panama does not maintain a check-the-box election or a domestic hybrid mismatch election. The Private Interest Foundation is treated as a separate taxpayer under Panamanian territorial source rules; only Panama-source income is subject to income tax, and foreign-source income is not taxed.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) — Panamanian VAT-type turnover tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/. 0 — no de minimis registration threshold; any habitual taxable transfer of goods or provision of services in Panama triggers compulsory ITBMS registration. A simplified small-taxpayer regime is available for annual gross receipts up to B/. 200,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for active RUC holders. Export invoices must be issued through DGI-approved software and transmitted to DGI's Sede Electrónica via API before delivery; each invoice receives a DGI fiscal authorization code and a CSV verification/QR stamp. A zero-rated export transaction must be explicitly marked as 'Exportación' and linked to the corresponding customs export declaration.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for 0% ITBMS where the RPG dice are physically exported from Panama to a foreign purchaser, clear Panamanian customs, and are not consumed, resold, or modified within Panama. Services may qualify as zero-rated offshore services only if rendered for non-resident recipients and used exclusively outside Panama. Evidence of collection in foreign currency and foreign destination is required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) formally lodged with Panama Customs
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export and foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign banking credit evidence showing payment by the foreign buyer
E-export invoice authorized by DGI with the zero-rated export marker
Transport contract and customs seal / exit certificate issued by the customs authority
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and Panama Customs may cross-match export declarations, ITBMS e-invoices, transport documents, and incoming bank remittances. Failure to remit or document foreign payment within the 180-day period causes reversal of the 0% rate, immediate reassessment at 7% ITBMS, plus interest, late-payment surcharges, and fines. Fraudulent zero-rating claims, fictitious exports, or forged customs documentation expose the foundation and its signatories to tax evasion penalties and criminal liability under the Panamanian Tax Code.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of Panama operates without a central bank empowered to issue national currency; the United States Dollar circulates as legal tender under Law 84 of 1904, while the Balboa exists only as a fractional coin. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), established by Decreto Ley No. 9 of 1998, is the exclusive banking regulator and supervisor. The Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), created by Law 23 of 2015, exercises AML/CFT supervision and acts as the financial intelligence unit. The Banco Nacional de Panamá serves as fiscal agent of the Republic but performs no monetary-policy function; no Panamanian authority issues banknotes or grants foreign-exchange authorizations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Convertibility is complete and unrestricted. Panama maintains no foreign-exchange control law, no capital-account approval system, and no currency rationing. Current-account flows from the PIF's online sale of handmade epoxy-resin RPG dice through Kickstarter, Stripe, and PayPal may be received, retained, and remitted abroad in USD or any freely convertible currency. Capital-account movements, including the settlement of the Foundation's initial patrimony, distributions to beneficiaries, and dissolution surpluses, are likewise free of central-bank clearance. Under the territorial-source tax doctrine preserved and modernized by Law 254 of 2024, extraterritorial income generated by sales perfected outside Panama to non-resident customers through foreign payment platforms is not subject to Panamanian income tax; consequently no profit-remittance tax, dividend withholding, or repatriation authorization applies to foreign-source proceeds. Practical constraints are limited to bank-level KYC/AML verification, not monetary regulation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline. Export receipts from the dice business may remain indefinitely in USD or any other freely chosen currency in the PIF's accounts. The applicable regime is AML notification rather than surrender: banks must record cash transactions above USD 10,000, preserve wire-transfer records for at least five years, and report suspicious or unusually aggregated movements to the UAF in accordance with Law 23 of 2015 and SBP Agreement 3 of 2015. Retaining the crowdfunding settlement reports, trade contracts, and shipping documentation fully satisfies these obligations without converting any funds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Institutional USD Operational Treasury Account with a separate Capital Escrow Sub-Account for the declared initial patrimony
Corporate Business Current Account with SWIFT correspondent capabilities and trade-finance modules

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank, Inc. — Panama Branch (Grupo Aval)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account combined with Commercial Letter of Credit and FX forward dealing facilities
Corporate Checking and Money-Market Account for operational balances
International Banking Foundation Account with private-client relationship management and escrow features

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Flat Franchise Tax Payment for Private Interest Foundation (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto de Operaciones)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Panama Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by June 30; applicable to foundations in existence as of the preceding December 31; first payment due in the year following registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers statutory interest and monetary surcharges; prolonged non-payment may cause the Public Registry to place the foundation in default, leading to administrative cancellation or strike-off and loss of legal capacity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuous Maintenance Record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Public Registry of Panama (Registro Público de Panamá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The registered agent and registered office must be maintained continuously; no annual separate filing, but any change or agent resignation must be recorded within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent or office in Panama subjects the foundation to fines, administrative strike-off, and restrictions on the filing of documents or disposal of assets in Panama

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable for standard Private Interest Foundations deriving exclusively foreign-source income; no mandatory independent audit is imposed by Panamanian law for this offshore vehicle. A statutory audit may become necessary if the foundation engages in onshore economic activities in Panama or is treated as an onshore taxpayer under territorial tax rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No specific mandatory accounting framework for Private Interest Foundations; internal accounting records may be maintained under home-jurisdiction GAAP or IFRS, provided they enable determination of the foundation's assets, liabilities, and activities. If onshore Panamanian activities arise, simplified Panamanian GAAP rules apply.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Law 23 of 2017 and the Private Interest Foundation Law require the registered agent to identify and maintain current beneficial ownership records. The foundation council or officer should provide an annual written confirmation of any changes in beneficiaries or foundation members; such confirmation is retained by the registered agent and is not publicly filed. In the absence of an annual confirmation, the registered agent must flag the account as non-compliant and may be required to report the inconsistency to the supervisory authority.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; if requested by banking or transaction counterparties, approximately US$2,000 - US$6,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% on foreign-source income under Panama's territorial tax scope; Private Interest Foundations deriving exclusively non-Panamanian-source income fall outside the income tax base. The only mandatory state charge is the annual foundation tax of USD 350; distributions from foreign-situs assets are not subject to Panamanian dividend withholding tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1192 (Declaración Jurada del Impuesto sobre la Renta – Personas Jurídicas) filed electronically through the SIT (Sistema Integrado Tributario) at https://sit.dgi.gob.pa
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the close of the fiscal year; for calendar-year taxpayers, due by March 31 of the following year. DGI may grant extensions; non-calendar fiscal years require prior notification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification Number (RUC) and Foundation Registry Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Panama RUC of the Private Interest Foundation; if a non-resident foundation, furnish the foundation's foreign address and agent details.

Include all income realized in Panama (e.g., local sales, services physically rendered in Panama). Foreign sales through Kickstarter, Stripe or PayPal are not Panamanian-source unless connected to a Panama-located production activity.
Report separately as informational only; do not enter into taxable base. Attach an annexe describing the income and the entity and jurisdiction generating it.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating costs and expenses directly attributable to Panamanian-source income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only expenses that are direct, necessary and evidenced by invoices and contracts; allocate common overheads using a reasonable ratio.
If Box 110 minus Box 130 is zero or negative, enter zero. Losses may be carried forward to offset future Panamanian-source income within five years.
Multiply net taxable income by 25%. If no Panamanian-source income, enter '0' and submit the return with a sworn declaration of non-operational status.
Apply prepayments and withholding credits; if a refund is claimed, upload supporting certificates. Non-residents should indicate an address in Panama for service of process.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission triggers a surcharge of 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction thereof, up to a maximum of 50%, plus moratory interest. Misdeclarations are sanctioned with fines of 100% to 200% of the omitted tax and, in cases of fraud, criminal proceedings may be initiated.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends declared from Panamanian-source net profits; distributions by a PIF of foreign-situs assets or out of non-Panamanian-source earnings are not within the Panamanian dividend WHT regime.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced or zero withholding under a Double Taxation Agreement (DTA), the beneficial owner must submit the applicable DGI form, attach a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the DTA residency jurisdiction, evidence entitlement under the limitation-on-benefits clause, and file the request before or at the time of the remittance; approval is recorded in the SIT withholding module.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest remitted to non-residents is generally subject to 6% Panama withholding; royalties and technical service payments to non-residents are generally subject to 12.5% withholding. DTA rates may reduce these to 0-5% where Panama has an applicable treaty.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 1,500,000 annual gross revenue of the Panamanian entity triggers mandatory transfer pricing documentation (Local File and contemporaneous TP study); groups with consolidated revenues above USD 50,000,000 must additionally prepare a Master File and, when applicable, Country-by-Country Reporting.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) require any entity engaged in 'relevant activities'—including IP holding, distribution and service centres, financing, leasing, or headquarters—to demonstrate proportionate staff, premises and effective management in Panama. A PIF holding only foreign financial assets and not conducting Panamanian commercial activity may fall within the 'pure equity holding entity' exemption; an active dice-casting or IP-licensing operation in Panama must satisfy ESR reporting and substance evidence to avoid reclassification as a shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Tax Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilfully excluding Panamanian-source income from Form 1192, inflating deductions, or secretly transferring revenue to a foreign nominee to create foreign-source appearance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil reassessment with a 100%-200% fraud penalty, default interest, and criminal conviction carrying imprisonment and fines under the Panama Penal Tax Regime; the foundation's bank accounts can be seized.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign or cause false declarations are jointly and severally liable for the omitted taxes, may be prohibited from leaving Panama, and face confinement of up to eight years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Foundation and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a PIF with no physical office, no employees, no board activity, and using a Panamanian registered agent solely for the purpose of tax avoidance or to conceal the true owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Panama may impose ESR penalties (monthly fines for non-compliance), strike the foundation from the Registro Público, and deny all tax benefits; the DGI may recharacterise the foundation as a sham and tax the beneficial owner directly.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil courts may pierce the foundation veil against directors and officers, order restitution of distributed assets to creditors, impose travel bans and disqualification from serving as director in any Panamanian entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the PIF and payment platforms (Kickstarter, Stripe, PayPal) to simulate sales of polyhedral dice and layer proceeds derived from criminal conduct, or accepting proceeds from unverified third parties despite beneficial ownership concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Panama Law No. 23 of 2015, money laundering carries imprisonment of 5 to 12 years and fines up to USD 5 million; convicted assets are forfeited and the foundation's license is revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, trustees and the beneficial owner can be detained pre-trial, have personal and corporate assets frozen, be subjected to travel bans and surrender of passports, and face extradition to the predicate-crime jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the required beneficial ownership information with the Panamanian Beneficial Ownership Registry, or concealing a beneficial owner nominee structure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines from USD 500 up to USD 50,000, recurring penalties for continued non-compliance, and temporary suspension of the foundation's rights to distribute assets until filing is complete.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the compliance officer are personally liable for false filings, may be fined and disqualified, and may face criminal punishment if the omission is used to circumvent AML controls.
